concurrency.rule: If available Codex concurrency is lower than 32, every assignment is still created and queued. When a task finishes, the next queued task starts immediately.
startOrder: SRC01-SRC04 and every PF lane holding families start together — the conveyor and the builders are not sequential
VF lanes start on the first PF checkpoint, not on a completed assignment
FIX lanes start on the first FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED verdict
an empty PF lane starts the moment a source lane releases a family into it
concurrency.idleRule: A lane is idle only when no executable work exists for its kind. An empty PF lane at dispatch is idle because the source queue is empty for it, and the source lanes are the work that ends that.

assignments.preflightMustReturn: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY with every registered applicable check passing
rasterRule: **A missing Chromium is not a source blocker and it is not a legal blocker.** ENV-RAS01 established that this container cannot resolve or fetch one -- the Playwright CDN answers HTTP 403 from inside Codex. That is an environment fact about the container, not a fact about the packet, and classifying it as BLOCKED_SOURCE would put a packet defect on a record that has none.
Finish every nonvisual obligation. Record the exact SHA-256 of the canonical and boundary PDFs you produced. Return the family `BUILT_RASTER_PENDING`.

`BUILT_RASTER_PENDING` is a factory workflow state and not a launch verdict. It zeroes nothing and waives nothing: visualDefects stays whatever it is, because it records that nobody has looked, not that there is nothing to see. **No packet becomes PASS_COMPLETE without RASTER_PASS.**

The render happens in `.github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml` on a browser-equipped runner, against the exact bytes your hashes pin. RASTER_PASS sends the family to independent verification; RASTER_FAIL sends it to FIX.
Page rasters go through `scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs`. It discovers its own browser and calibrates the page-to-pixel mapping against both the paper bounds and stamped marks.
NEVER `pdftoppm`. NEVER `apt-get`. NEVER `playwright install`. The environment refuses package installation and a Poppler fallback is not a fallback, it is a different measurement.
The preflight now gates on the rasterizer resolving a browser it can execute, so a lane that cannot raster learns before it builds rather than after.
claimRule: Assert every family before reading or writing anything: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert PF01 <familyId>`
A non-zero exit is a full stop for that family: report `BLOCKED_BEFORE_CLAIM` naming the exact refusal, and read none of its artifacts.
Release each family when it is finished: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --release PF01 <familyId>`, and leave that in your diff.
assignments.theDiffIsTheReturn: Commit locally. Leave the final diff for the Codex Cloud interface. There is no PUSHED line in a cloud return.
assignments.mission: Build 5 packet families to the builder contract, one at a time, checkpointing as you go. A family that stops does not stop the lane.
assignments.refillRule: When a source lane releases a family, Captain appends it to the emptiest PF lane and the lane starts it without waiting for the rest of the source lane to finish.
builderObligations: bind every source by exact SHA-256, and stop the family rather than build on a source that does not bind
render canonical and boundary artifacts
include every required component the route names — a document mapped and not rendered is a missing companion form
fill every known required fact
classify every intentional blank against the closed vocabulary
identify a missing participant fact as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, declared explicitly and disclosed in participant-instructions.md
select every route-determined option — a packet built for one statutory route states which route it is
complete every repeating case and offence row, because a partly-filled row reads as finished and is not
leave every protected field blank — participant signature, signature date, certificate of mailing before mailing, court-only and prosecutor-only
generate participant instructions and filing instructions
render all page rasters through scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs, which discovers its own browser
verify the actual visible writes from the final PDF bytes, not from the finalizer's own report
return all nine completeness counters equal to zero, or return the family as STOPPED with the counter that is not

laneGate.mustReturn: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY with every registered applicable check passing
laneGate.onFailure: If it does not, STOP THE LANE: nothing in it can run and no row is written.
laneGate.note: family_sources_bind reports 'not applicable' here on purpose: it is a row question, asked once per family below.

rowGate.onFamilySourcesBindFailure: write a BLOCKED_SOURCE row for that family naming the exact source identity that did not bind, and CONTINUE TO THE NEXT FAMILY.
rowGate.onOpenLegalInput: write a BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT row naming the open input, and CONTINUE TO THE NEXT FAMILY. Never guess a legal answer and never research one.
rowGate.onAnyOtherCheckFailing: that is a lane-level environment change, not a family defect. Stop the lane and say which check moved.

rowStopContract.everyFamilyGetsExactlyOneRow: COMPLETED or STOPPED, one row per assigned family, no family missing and none twice. A lane that returns fewer rows than it was assigned families has lost work silently.
rowStopContract.aStoppedFamilyWritesNothing: A family you stop must leave its overlay directory byte-for-byte unchanged. A half-built packet that reads as built is worse than one that was never started.
rowStopContract.theLaneCompletesNormally: A lane with blocked families still completes. Blocked rows are the finding, not a failure of the lane.

builderObligations: bind every source by exact SHA-256, and stop the family rather than build on a source that does not bind
render canonical and boundary artifacts
include every required component the route names — a document mapped and not rendered is a missing companion form
fill every known required fact
classify every intentional blank against the closed vocabulary
identify a missing participant fact as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, declared explicitly and disclosed in participant-instructions.md
select every route-determined option — a packet built for one statutory route states which route it is
complete every repeating case and offence row, because a partly-filled row reads as finished and is not
leave every protected field blank — participant signature, signature date, certificate of mailing before mailing, court-only and prosecutor-only
generate participant instructions and filing instructions
render all page rasters through scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs, which discovers its own browser
verify the actual visible writes from the final PDF bytes, not from the finalizer's own report
return all nine completeness counters equal to zero, or return the family as STOPPED with the counter that is not

laneGate.mustReturn: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY with every registered applicable check passing
laneGate.onFailure: If it does not, STOP THE LANE: nothing in it can run and no row is written.
laneGate.note: family_sources_bind reports 'not applicable' here on purpose: it is a row question, asked once per family below.

rowGate.onFamilySourcesBindFailure: write a BLOCKED_SOURCE row for that family naming the exact source identity that did not bind, and CONTINUE TO THE NEXT FAMILY.
rowGate.onOpenLegalInput: write a BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT row naming the open input, and CONTINUE TO THE NEXT FAMILY. Never guess a legal answer and never research one.
rowGate.onAnyOtherCheckFailing: that is a lane-level environment change, not a family defect. Stop the lane and say which check moved.

rowStopContract.everyFamilyGetsExactlyOneRow: COMPLETED or STOPPED, one row per assigned family, no family missing and none twice. A lane that returns fewer rows than it was assigned families has lost work silently.
rowStopContract.aStoppedFamilyWritesNothing: A family you stop must leave its overlay directory byte-for-byte unchanged. A half-built packet that reads as built is worse than one that was never started.
rowStopContract.theLaneCompletesNormally: A lane with blocked families still completes. Blocked rows are the finding, not a failure of the lane.

rasterRule: **A missing Chromium is not a source blocker and it is not a legal blocker.** ENV-RAS01 established that this container cannot resolve or fetch one -- the Playwright CDN answers HTTP 403 from inside Codex. That is an environment fact about the container, not a fact about the packet, and classifying it as BLOCKED_SOURCE would put a packet defect on a record that has none.
Finish every nonvisual obligation. Record the exact SHA-256 of the canonical and boundary PDFs you produced. Return the family `BUILT_RASTER_PENDING`.

`BUILT_RASTER_PENDING` is a factory workflow state and not a launch verdict. It zeroes nothing and waives nothing: visualDefects stays whatever it is, because it records that nobody has looked, not that there is nothing to see. **No packet becomes PASS_COMPLETE without RASTER_PASS.**

The render happens in `.github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml` on a browser-equipped runner, against the exact bytes your hashes pin. RASTER_PASS sends the family to independent verification; RASTER_FAIL sends it to FIX.
Page rasters go through `scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs`. It discovers its own browser and calibrates the page-to-pixel mapping against both the paper bounds and stamped marks.
NEVER `pdftoppm`. NEVER `apt-get`. NEVER `playwright install`. The environment refuses package installation and a Poppler fallback is not a fallback, it is a different measurement.
The preflight now gates on the rasterizer resolving a browser it can execute, so a lane that cannot raster learns before it builds rather than after.
claimRule: Assert every family before reading or writing anything: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert PF10 <familyId>`
A non-zero exit is a full stop for that family: report `BLOCKED_BEFORE_CLAIM` naming the exact refusal, and read none of its artifacts.
Release each family when it is finished: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --release PF10 <familyId>`, and leave that in your diff.

statesThatAreNotAFetch.BUNDLE_COMPONENT: 3 — the document is a page inside a public bundle whose address is already recorded. Record the component locator and alias. Acquire the BUNDLE once, never the page.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.EMBEDDED_SECTION: 3 — the document is a section inside another form. There is no separate binary to request from anyone.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.STALE_OR_VARIANT_ID: 2 — the identity is missing its current suffix or its filing-mode variant. Normalize the identity first; the form is public.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.SOURCE_SCOPE_AND_VERSION_AMBIGUITY: 1 — statewide versus local scope is unsettled. Settle the scope before any inquiry.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.FAMILY_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS: 7 — several held artifacts match this identity. Which one the route requires is the question; do not pick one.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIED: 60 — the corpus already HOLDS matching bytes. The open question is whether the publisher still issues that edition. This is not a missing source and it is not an acquisition.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.STATUTORY_CUSTOM_PLEADING: 6 — a statutory citation. There is no document at the other end; a packet-build lane drafts against the statute.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.LICENSE_PERMISSION_REVIEW: 2 — the form is public and its publisher restricts commercial reuse. Counsel and business decide, not a clerk.

statesThatAreAFetch.MISSING_SOURCE_BINARY: 3 — expected and absent; acquire once an exact address is settled.
statesThatAreAFetch.MISSING_CANONICAL_RELATIONSHIP_METADATA: 142 — no publisher, address or locator is recorded. Settle identity before fetching.

sourceRelationshipRegistry.neverAskAClerkWhenAPublicSourceIsKnown: The previous human queue told a person to contact a clerk 101 times. Zero of the top twenty justified it. If the registry records an official source page, the answer is already known.
sourceRelationshipRegistry.youDoNotDecideReuse: A publisher's commercial-reuse restriction is a counsel and business decision. Record it; do not resolve it and do not ask a clerk about it.

outputSchema.rule: An unrecognised status is refused at integration rather than translated.

stopConditions: NEVER guess a form number and never accept an unofficial mirror. A secondary copy does not override an available official original.

statesThatAreNotAFetch.SOURCE_SCOPE_AND_VERSION_AMBIGUITY: 1 — statewide versus local scope is unsettled. Settle the scope before any inquiry.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.FAMILY_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS: 7 — several held artifacts match this identity. Which one the route requires is the question; do not pick one.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIED: 60 — the corpus already HOLDS matching bytes. The open question is whether the publisher still issues that edition. This is not a missing source and it is not an acquisition.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.STATUTORY_CUSTOM_PLEADING: 6 — a statutory citation. There is no document at the other end; a packet-build lane drafts against the statute.
statesThatAreNotAFetch.LICENSE_PERMISSION_REVIEW: 2 — the form is public and its publisher restricts commercial reuse. Counsel and business decide, not a clerk.

statesThatAreAFetch.MISSING_SOURCE_BINARY: 3 — expected and absent; acquire once an exact address is settled.
statesThatAreAFetch.MISSING_CANONICAL_RELATIONSHIP_METADATA: 142 — no publisher, address or locator is recorded. Settle identity before fetching.

assignments.dispatchImmediately: The moment a family's last source is promoted, report it released. Captain assigns it to the next available PF lane without waiting for this lane to finish.
assignments.promotionRule: A source is promoted only with exact bytes: a custody path that exists and a SHA-256 that matches the indexed entry. A promotion without bytes releases a family into a builder that cannot open its source.
assignments.releaseRule: Prospective release is never actual release. Record familiesActuallyReleasedNow only after every remaining source binds; otherwise it is an empty array.
assignments.continueAfterFailure: An obligation that cannot be settled is a STOPPED row. The lane continues to the next one.
assignments.egressReality: This environment refuses outbound egress to court and agency hosts. Identity and inventory work runs here; anything needing a fetch is dispatched through the acquisition workflow, never attempted locally and never faked.
requiredOutputs: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/promo03/rows.json — one row per obligation: itemId, status, the identity or receipt, and the families it releases
data/rcap-grade-a/source-acquisition/packet-factory-24h/promo03/receipts.json — the eleven recorded fields per resolved source; no body is committed

outputSchema.rule: An unrecognised status is refused at integration rather than translated.

stopConditions: NEVER guess a form number and never accept an unofficial mirror. A secondary copy does not override an available official original.
NEVER commit a source body, an extracted archive or anything under private/. A receipt carrying an exact hash is the deliverable.
NEVER promote a source without exact bytes. A promotion is a release, and a released family goes to a builder that will try to open the file.
LANE STOP — you build no packet and you touch no overlay directory.
ROW STOP — an obligation that cannot be settled here is STOPPED naming the exact host and the next operation that owns it.
returnFormat: DIFF LEFT FOR THE CODEX UI: YES
assignments.grantsNothing: A bound source is a bound source. It builds nothing, proves nothing and approves nothing.

assignments.preflightMustReturn: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY with every registered applicable check passing
rasterRule: **A missing Chromium is not a source blocker and it is not a legal blocker.** ENV-RAS01 established that this container cannot resolve or fetch one -- the Playwright CDN answers HTTP 403 from inside Codex. That is an environment fact about the container, not a fact about the packet, and classifying it as BLOCKED_SOURCE would put a packet defect on a record that has none.
Finish every nonvisual obligation. Record the exact SHA-256 of the canonical and boundary PDFs you produced. Return the family `BUILT_RASTER_PENDING`.

`BUILT_RASTER_PENDING` is a factory workflow state and not a launch verdict. It zeroes nothing and waives nothing: visualDefects stays whatever it is, because it records that nobody has looked, not that there is nothing to see. **No packet becomes PASS_COMPLETE without RASTER_PASS.**

The render happens in `.github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml` on a browser-equipped runner, against the exact bytes your hashes pin. RASTER_PASS sends the family to independent verification; RASTER_FAIL sends it to FIX.
Page rasters go through `scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs`. It discovers its own browser and calibrates the page-to-pixel mapping against both the paper bounds and stamped marks.
NEVER `pdftoppm`. NEVER `apt-get`. NEVER `playwright install`. The environment refuses package installation and a Poppler fallback is not a fallback, it is a different measurement.
The preflight now gates on the rasterizer resolving a browser it can execute, so a lane that cannot raster learns before it builds rather than after.
claimRule: Assert every family before reading or writing anything: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --assert FIX01 <familyId>`
A non-zero exit is a full stop for that family: report `BLOCKED_BEFORE_CLAIM` naming the exact refusal, and read none of its artifacts.
Release each family when it is finished: `node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/claim.mjs --release FIX01 <familyId>`, and leave that in your diff.
assignments.theDiffIsTheReturn: Commit locally. Leave the final diff for the Codex Cloud interface. There is no PUSHED line in a cloud return.
assignments.mission: Repair exactly the proof obligations a verifier failed, on exactly the families it failed them on. Nothing else.
assignments.seedItemsAreNotTheWholeJob: These are the families already failing at dispatch. The rest arrive as VF verdicts land.
assignments.receivesOnly: the failed families and their exact failed proof obligations
assignments.doNotRepeatAnalysis: A repair lane does not repeat broad family analysis. If the failure is not reproducible from the obligations you were given, stop and say so rather than re-deriving the family.
assignments.reverificationRule: After repair, the family goes to a verifier that is neither its builder nor its repairer. Captain routes it; you do not choose.

failedObligations.finding: THE BOUND SOURCE NAMES THREE SETS OF PAGES IT REQUIRES AND NOTHING SUPPLIES THEM, AND THE DELIVERED PACKET IS NOT A FILING WITHOUT THEM. This is not inferred from a report — it is printed on the delivered artifact, and this lane read it there. pdftotext of fixtures/packet-canonical-filled.pdf: PAGE 4 prints, as the entire page, 'Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Facts pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)'; PAGE 10 prints 'Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Findings pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)'; PAGE 11 prints 'Take out this page and insert your non-conviction Exhibit pages (from the Non Conviction Insert Forms)'. Three of the fifteen delivered pages are placeholders for pages the packet does not contain. The consequence is stated by the source's own text elsewhere in the bundle: without the Facts pages the petition alleges nothing about the arrest, charge or allegation to be expunged; without the Findings pages the proposed order gives the judge nothing to find; and without the Exhibit pages there is no Exhibit A, which the order's own paragraph 1(a) requires as the place for 'all information necessary to identify particular agency records that are to be expunged pursuant to this Order' under I.C. § 35-38-9-1(g). THE BUILD DECLARED THIS ITSELF and was right to: reports/missing-companion-forms.json answers its own question 'YES. Three sets of insert pages, named by the bound source on three of its own pages', records 'COMPONENT_SET is an OPEN FINDING for this family', and explains why no completeness counter can see it — 'The nine packet-completeness counters measure the blanks on the pages that ARE in the bound binary. They cannot see a page that is absent, so all nine can be zero while the packet is unfilable.' This lane confirms both halves independently: all nine counters are zero, and the packet is not a filing. An honest self-declaration is a reason to trust the builder, not a reason to score the obligation as met. The close is a source lane acquiring the Coalition for Court Access Non Conviction Insert Forms and binding them, not an edit in a repair lane.

THE PARTICIPANT'S OWN NAME IS WRITTEN INTO FOUR WIDGETS THAT CANNOT HOLD IT, AT A FONT SIZE 0.01pt ABOVE THE READABLE FLOOR, AND EACH APPEARANCE STREAM CLIPS IT. This is the boundary fixture, whose job is to find exactly this. METHOD: every flattened widget appearance in fixtures/packet-boundary-filled.pdf was decoded from its Form XObject — the /BBox, the clip path, the /Tf size and the hex Tj string — and the required text width was computed with pdf-lib's Helvetica metrics at that widget's own size and compared with that widget's own usable width. The value is the 70-character boundary name 'Alexandrina-Katharine Montgomery-Vandenberg-Oyelaran y Fitzwilliam III', set at 6.01pt, requiring 195.97pt. Every appearance stream carries an explicit clip, 'W n', inset 1pt on each side. FOUR OF THE SIXTEEN WIDGETS WITH TEXT CANNOT TAKE IT: /FlatWidget-7888911063 on page 1, BBox 196.99, usable 194.99, over by 0.98pt; /FlatWidget-2708199956 on page 7 at x=332.887 y=463.385, BBox 187.88, usable 185.88, OVER BY 10.09pt; /FlatWidget-6703682664 on page 7 at x=406.387 y=449.662, BBox 161.12, usable 159.12, OVER BY 36.84pt; /FlatWidget-9668333493 on page 9 at x=124.733 y=493.345, BBox 182.19, usable 180.19, OVER BY 15.78pt. The same string fits in the ten other widgets it is written into, which range from 200.98 to 342.16. WHY THIS IS A DEFECT AND NOT THE PERMITTED REFUSAL: docs/RCAP_OREGON_OFFICIAL_PDF_GRADE_A_LANE_C.md protects a value that is REFUSED at the 6pt readable floor and left blank for the participant. This value was not refused. reports/rendered-artifacts.json lists exactly two unfittable refusals on the boundary fixture — cap-COUNTY and Address, both with reason value_exceeds_widget_width_at_minimum_font — and cap-PetitionerFullName is not among them; it was written. THE LIKELY MECHANISM, offered as a lead and not as a finding: production-field-map.json records ONE writeBox for cap-PetitionerFullName, on page 1, rect width 210.08, rectBasis 'acroform_widget_rect_read_from_the_document'. The AcroForm field has fourteen widget kids across ten pages with widths from 161.12 to 342.16. A fitter that sizes to one recorded rect and applies the result to every kid produces exactly this: a size that fits the box it measured and overruns three others. WHAT THE PARTICIPANT SEES: a PDF viewer honours the Form XObject clip, so the name is truncated mid-word on the filed pages rather than printed over neighbouring text. On page 7 the surname is cut off in the line 'Contemporaneous with the filing of this notice, ______ has filed'; on page 9 in the order's own 'Petitioner, ______,'. The canonical fixture is clean: 26 widget appearances, zero exceeding their clip box. RESIDUAL LIMIT, STATED PLAINLY: this is a geometric computation from the appearance streams, not a pixel reading. This lane inspected no raster. The central raster receipt for this family records 0 problems over 30 pages, which is not a contradiction — a clip guarantees no ink lands outside its box, so an ink-outside-the-box check cannot see a value truncated inside one. The two instruments answer different questions and this one answers the question the Lane C rule is about.

(8) 'The person is a sex or violent offender or subject to registration' — 'sex offender' 0/0, 'registration' 0/0. (9) 'Fines, fees, costs or restitution are unpaid or disputed' — 'restitution' 0/0. (11) 'The record involves a commercial driver's licence and 49 C.F.R. 384.226' — '384.226' 0/0, 'CDL' 0 in the instructions. (13) 'The person wants to attack the underlying conviction rather than expunge it' — 'attack' 0/0. THE PACKET TELLS THE PARTICIPANT IT WROTE THEIR MAILING ADDRESS ONTO THE PETITION, AND IT DID NOT. Two participant-facing sentences say it did. The component table: 'the Massachusetts Probation Service Petition to Expunge itself, Rev. 10/11/2018, with your name, date of birth, MAILING ADDRESS and phone written in and every other blank left for you'. And the closing section: 'This is the official Massachusetts Probation Service Petition to Expunge with the FOUR facts the platform holds written into it'. There are three. reports/actual-writes.json reports 3 values in each fixture -- petitioner_name, date_of_birth, phone_number -- and I confirmed the absence on the delivered bytes rather than on the report: extracting page 1 of both fixtures with pdftotext -bbox-layout and reading the band that contains the mailing_address write box (field-map rect x=105 y=484 w=171 h=13, which is y_top 295-308 on a 792pt page), the only words present are the form's own printed captions 'Mailing Address:', 'City:', 'State:', 'Zip:' at x=28.42-100.93, 280.42, 415.42 and 514.42. The 171-point run from x=105 to x=276 is empty in the canonical fixture and empty in the boundary fixture. This is the A4 defect with its sign reversed -- the rule is that a packet may never tell a participant it does not state something it does state, and the harm here is the mirror image and worse in direction: a participant who reads the component table and believes the address is on the form will not transcribe it, and will file a petition with the Probation Service that has no address on it to answer. The packet contradicts itself three times over in the participant's favour -- 'Your address is not filled in, and that is deliberate', the street-address row in the items-to-supply table, and 'The whole address - street, city, state and zip' in the deliberately-left-blank list -- which is exactly why a reader cannot tell which sentence to believe. The fix is two words in two sentences, not a rebuild.

failedObligations.finding: ONE OF THE FIVE STOP CONDITIONS THE REGISTRY HOLDS FOR THIS TRACK IS ABSENT FROM THE PACKET IN ANY FORM, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT COSTS A PARTICIPANT THE ROUTE. I compared data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json trackId ma-expunge-time selfHelpStopConditions against participant-instructions.md and the delivered bytes, condition by condition, then grepped each condition's distinguishing terms. (1) 'Any offence may fall on the Sec. 100J list, several entries of which turn on facts rather than charge titles' -- carried: the packet reproduces the whole exclusion list. (2) 'Whether every offence occurred before the 21st birthday is unclear' -- carried, first bullet in both the md and the delivered page. (4) 'The district attorney objects' -- carried. (5) 'The court sets a hearing on the best interests of justice' -- carried in substance; the guidance states the hearing rule and 'the determination that expungement is in the interests of justice'. (3) 'WHETHER OFFENCES AROSE FROM A SINGLE INCIDENT FOR COUNTING PURPOSES IS UNCLEAR' -- ABSENT. The words 'incident', 'arising from', 'arose', 'counting' and 'count as one' appear NOWHERE in participant-instructions.md and NOWHERE in the delivered canonical bytes; I grepped each. What the packet does say is 'your record shows more than two convictions, or more than two non-conviction records - the section limits it to two.' The same registry entry holds the rule that resolves it, in its exclusions: 'More than two records. MULTIPLE OFFENCES ARISING FROM THE SAME INCIDENT COUNT AS ONE.' So the repository establishes both the counting rule and that uncertainty about it is where self-help stops, and the packet publishes neither. The direction of the harm is specific and one-way: a participant with three charges from one arrest reads the two-record limit, counts three, and abandons a route they are eligible for -- and no bullet tells them this is the moment to ask. Under A2 a committed registry is a held source; under A4 as extended, an obligation whose failure mode is omitting a fact the repository establishes is an ask-the-repository-first obligation. Both limbs are met and the omission is the whole of the failure.

failedObligations.finding: The service mechanics are right and the objection clock is wrong in a way that can mislead a felony-class petitioner. Correct: two recipients from the form's own Certificate of Service (the prosecuting or city attorney, and the arresting agency), the form's two methods, and the rule that the certificate is completed only after service. The defect is the objection window. The packet leads with a flat "The prosecuting attorney has 30 days to object", sourced to the committed packet-set manifest. I traced that sentence: it is data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/AR.memo.json rules.service, and it appears VERBATIM on 11 of the 12 Arkansas tracks in that file — including ar-felony-seal, where the same repository's compiled profile says the window is 90 days. A line that is provably wrong on a sibling track it is attached to is state-level boilerplate, not a route-addressed determination, and under A3 (holding is per FACT, not per document) it does not establish this route's answer. The record that DOES address it is the compiled profile's own table: "Prosecutor objection window - misdemeanor 30 days / felony 90 days, Receipt / filing of petition". That rule is self-applying here, because the delivered petition prints "A Class _____ [_] felony [_] misdemeanor" and the participant supplies the class. failedObligations.evidence: The filing instructions page states: 'No committed record this packet binds states a filing fee, or a fee waiver, for this route. The office that answers both is the clerk's office of the Mississippi court that granted nonadjudication…'. The profile it binds carries sourceSections[2], title 'Filing Fee', category 'fees': 'Mississippi Code 99-19-72 sets a $150 filing fee for each petition to expunge an offense under 99-19-71' and 'Expect at least a $150 statutory filing fee for many 99-19-71 petitions, but confirm with the clerk'. The same profile's packetGenerator.feeRules carries the same three lines. And the packet's own petition page tells the participant, quoting that profile, that the operative provision 'appears in both Sec. 99-15-26(5) and Sec. 99-19-71(4)'. Having told the participant the provision is shared with § 99-19-71, the packet cannot then say no bound record states a fee and send them to the clerk: that is the sibling fee trap A4 records, and it is not walked around. The comparison that settles it is inside this same lane: ms-misd-addl-set, built for §§ 9-11-15(3) and 21-23-7(6) where no such overlap is even asserted, devotes an entire block to naming the $150, naming § 99-19-72, and stating why it does not reach — 'THIS PETITION IS NOT BROUGHT UNDER SEC. 99-19-71 … the Sec. 99-19-72 fee does not reach those sections by its terms.' This packet, which has the stronger overlap, names neither section and neither figure. NOTE FOR THE REPAIR: A3 forbids the opposite error just as firmly. The repair is NOT to state that $150 applies to a § 99-15-26(5) petition. It is to name § 99-19-72 and § 99-19-71, state on this route's own terms whether the fee reaches it, and say what the record does and does not settle.

failedObligations.finding: The packet denies that the repository says anything about the cost of this route, and the record it binds says something about the cost of this route -- by name. participant-instructions.md and the delivered filing-instructions page both read: 'No committed record this packet binds states a filing fee, or a fee waiver, for this route.' The bound compiled profile, src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/WY-wyoming.json, which this family pins by exact SHA-256 and which I rehashed MATCH in this container, carries the row 'Human-trafficking victim vacatur Verify with clerk; statute is a motion route, not a standard expungement filing-fee route' -- twice, at packetGenerator.feeRules[4] and again in sourceSections[9].text, inside a Route/Fee table whose other four rows are keyed to 7-13-1401 ($0), 7-13-1501 ($100), 7-13-1502 ($300) and 14-6-241 ($0). The row is keyed to THIS route by its own label, so A3 does not excuse it: this is not a sibling statute's answer read across, it is this route's own line. What the packet withholds is not an amount -- there is none -- but the reason, and the reason is the participant's best instrument at the counter: told only 'ask the clerk', a participant quoted the $300 felony-expungement fee has nothing to say; told what the profile holds, they can say this is a motion in the existing case and not a standard expungement filing. Under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 A2 the compiled state profile is a held source, and under A4's narrow rule a packet may never tell a participant that it does not state something it does state. This is squarely the A2 error pattern the determination names: the claim about the bound FORMS would be fine; the claim about the REPOSITORY is false. The named authority is present and correct, so the participant can still act, and the repair is to publish what the profile holds rather than to find an amount that does not exist.

'What the order does' (the seal is irreversible; the record may not be opened even by court order) IS carried, on the filing-instructions page and in participant-instructions.md. 'What it does not reach' is NOT carried in any form: its required text is 'The order is directed at the court record. It does not by itself change records held by other agencies, and it is not a pardon. If you need a criminal-history record corrected as well, that is a separate request to the agency that holds it.' Grepping this route's six delivered pages (canonical 29-34) for its distinguishing terms returns nothing — 'other agencies' 0, 'not a pardon' 0, 'is not a pardon' 0, 'criminal history' 0, 'criminal-history record' 0, 'separate request' 0; the single hit for 'does not reach' on those pages is 'Other charges in the same case, which the subsection does not reach', a different proposition. participant-instructions.md carries none of it either. 'This is not the general sealing chapter' survives only as the half-sentence 'which makes this seal stronger than Chapter 12-60.1 sealing'; its required content — that 12-60.1's three-and-five-year waiting periods, its clear-and-convincing burden and its no-hearing-before-45-days rule do not apply here — is absent from this route's pages. That omission is participant-facing and it is made worse by the packet's own contents: the SAME artifact tells the participant three separate times, on the three Chapter 12-60.1 routes, that 'Sealing under Chapter 12-60.1 does not reach BCI criminal history record information or the criminal justice data system, and it does not reach federal, tribal, military, out-of-state or private-database records', and prints 'clear-and-convincing' and '45 days' on those pages.
